summary: A gateway-readable SQLite file's approved tables read as they are, with the person's declarations; any table, not only wells.

routes.data: Any table, as its columns and rows
losses: Columns of types outside the eight logical types are listed as not read; their values are not delivered and a change in them is not detected
Declared units, descriptions, missing-value markers and coordinates are annotations; no value is converted
SQLite NUMERIC and DECIMAL columns, and columns without a declared type, are not read
A table is read once inside one read-only snapshot, up to 100,000 rows, 64 MiB and 128 columns

redistribution: Ophiolite source in this repository; no third-party runtime needed.
